==Biography==
=== 2019 Harassment case ===
:''More info: [[2019 4LaN Harassment Incident]]''
In October 2019, '''4LaN''' left [[Team oNe eSports]] under bad circumstances, after having allegedly been confronted by [[Rakin]] at a party for harassing two women. He was officially reported and considered guilty by Brazilian justice in 2022, and he was convicted of 1 year in prison and the sentence was converted to community services.
